title: cli.websocket_laboratories_listener.LaboratoryAttachment
description:
One attachment row targeting this laboratory: the agent target it
is attached to — an AIH or a tag, exactly one (the DB row's
CHECK-exclusive pair) — plus when and by whom.

anyOf.title: Aih
anyOf.description: Attached directly to an agent instance hierarchy.

attached_at.description: Unix seconds when the attachment row was created.

attached_by.description: The AIH that performed the attach, when recorded.

machine.description:
The machine id the attachment row records (laboratory ids
are only unique per (machine, state)); `None` on rows
predating machine tracking.

machine_state.description: The state the attachment row records, paired with `machine`.

anyOf.title: Tag
anyOf.description:
Attached to a tag (BOUND or GROUPED — the row targets the tag
itself, wherever it points).

attached_at.description: Unix seconds when the attachment row was created.

attached_by.description: The AIH that performed the attach, when recorded.

machine.description:
The machine id the attachment row records (laboratory ids
are only unique per (machine, state)); `None` on rows
predating machine tracking.

machine_state.description: The state the attachment row records, paired with `machine`.
